title: Restriction and extension by zero for modules on a localized site
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a Grothendieck site [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology], let $U$ be an object, and let $\mathcal O$ be a sheaf of commutative rings on $\mathcal C$. Give $\mathcal C/U$ the localized topology and write $\operatorname{Mod}_{\mathcal O}(\mathcal C)$ and $\operatorname{Mod}_{\mathcal O|_U}(\mathcal C/U)$ for the categories of sheaves of modules [def-pur-localized-ringed-site] [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Let $j_U^*:\operatorname{Mod}_{\mathcal O}(\mathcal C)\to\operatorname{Mod}_{\mathcal O|_U}(\mathcal C/U)$ be restriction, $G\mapsto G|_U$ [def-pur-localized-ringed-site], and for a sheaf $F$ of $\mathcal O|_U$-modules let $j_{U!}F=P_F^\#$ be the sheafification [def-weil-presheaf-modules-sheafification] of its extension-by-zero presheaf of $\mathcal O$-modules $P_F$ [def-weil-extension-by-zero-presheaf], functorial in $F$ (the *extension by zero*). Then $j_U^*$ is an exact functor, and $j_{U!}$ is an exact functor left adjoint to it: $\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal O}(j_{U!}F,G)\cong\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal O|_U}(F,j_U^*G)$ naturally in the $\mathcal O|_U$-module $F$ and the $\mathcal O$-module $G$.

source.place: Section 03DH and Lemma 03DJ (lemma-extension-by-zero and exactness), with the same construction in sheaves of modules

proof.text: The restriction $j_U^*$ is a functor on module sheaves by the definition of the localized ringed site: it keeps the section groups and restriction maps on objects $V\to U$, and the action of $\mathcal O|_U(V\to U)=\mathcal O(V)$ is the restricted action. The extension-by-zero presheaf $P_F$ is a presheaf of $\mathcal O$-modules by [def-weil-extension-by-zero-presheaf], and its module sheafification $P_F^\#$ is the stated $j_{U!}F$ by [def-weil-presheaf-modules-sheafification]. Thus both assignments are functors on the displayed module categories.

source.place: Section 03DH and Lemma 03DI, construction of the module extension by zero

proof.text: The abelian sheafification of the underlying presheaf of $P_F$ is the direct-sum presheaf extension by zero for the underlying abelian sheaf of $F$, by [def-weil-extension-by-zero-presheaf] and the underlying-sheaf clause of [lem-pc-sites-module-sheafification-interface]. Hence the underlying abelian functor of $j_{U!}$ is the sheafified direct-sum functor of [lem-weil-pbc-site-extension-by-zero-presheaf-adjoint], while the underlying functor of $j_U^*$ is abelian restriction. The natural bijection of that node therefore gives the required bijection of underlying hom-sets. In the explicit sectionwise formula, multiplication by $a\in\mathcal O(V)$ is carried to multiplication by its restriction in $\mathcal O|_U(V\to U)$; therefore a map and its adjoint are $\mathcal O$-linear simultaneously. The underlying bijection thus restricts to a natural bijection $\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal O}(j_{U!}F,G)\cong\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal O|_U}(F,j_U^*G)$.

source.place: Lemma 03DI, adjunction construction, with the module linearity in the paragraph after the presheaf formula

proof.text: For a short exact sequence of $\mathcal O$-module sheaves, forgetting the module structure gives a short exact sequence of abelian sheaves by the faithful exactness of the forgetful functor in [lem-weil-pbc-module-sheaves-colimits-forgetful]. Applying the exact abelian restriction functor [lem-weil-pbc-site-restriction-exact] gives a short exact sequence after restriction. The underlying sequence of the restricted module sequence is therefore exact, and faithfulness and exactness of forgetting imply that $j_U^*$ is exact.

source.place: Lemma 03DJ, restriction exactness assertion and the module forgetful-functor lemma 03DA

proof.text: Likewise, forgetting a short exact sequence of $\mathcal O|_U$-module sheaves gives a short exact sequence of abelian sheaves. By Step 2 the underlying abelian functor of $j_{U!}$ is the sheafified direct-sum functor, a left adjoint of abelian restriction by [lem-weil-pbc-site-extension-by-zero-presheaf-adjoint]; the functor $j_{U!}$ of [lem-weil-pbc-site-extension-by-zero-exact] is the left adjoint of [lem-weil-pbc-site-restriction-adjunction], so the two are naturally isomorphic by uniqueness of adjoints, and exactness passes along the isomorphism. Hence [lem-weil-pbc-site-extension-by-zero-exact] makes the underlying sequence after applying $j_{U!}$ short exact. The forgetful functor is faithful and exact by [lem-weil-pbc-module-sheaves-colimits-forgetful], hence the module sequence itself is short exact. Thus $j_{U!}$ is exact.
